description: The races, chamber control and the national House popular vote that pundits have called in an election cycle (the current one unless you pass cycle), most-called first: how many pundits called each, how the field splits (each pundit's latest pick counted once, and split into forecasters and commentators), calls in the last 7 days, and the VoteHub polling average where one exists. Filter by office (president, senate, house, governor, chamber, national) or two-letter state. Use it to find a race slug.

cycle.description: The election cycle year. Omit for the current cycle.
